notes.title: Post-Launch Update
notes.notes:
Thanks so much to everyone who has supported Pack It Out in its earliest form. We have a big update for you today addressing some early feedback. 


The new update includes the following gameplay changes:

Added a Ranger Journal – track your findings, lifetime trash collected, and get hints as to what’s still out there!

Chick behavior improvements – you can now bring your trusty canine companion to Lucy Falls!

New wildlife to encounter – foxes and stags now roam the park!

New cryptid to encounter – rumors tell of strange encounters in Lucy Falls at night.

How to Play – explains controls and interactable objects.

We have also updated the store page and trailer to better reflect the game’s new features, so go check it out!


Sincerely, 
A couple of dead bugs.
